recognize_zh: 箭頭處骨小樑旁有一小群大型細胞，細胞質豐富、嗜雙性，核偏位、有明顯核仁，其中可見雙核細胞，比周圍造血細胞大很多，符合骨髓瘤的大型不典型漿細胞聚集。
features: Small cluster of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm (arrow)
Eccentric round nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli
Located in paratrabecular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula
Background of fat and mixed hematopoietic cells with hemorrhage
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula with a small cluster of large atypical cells (arrow) having abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, including binucleate forms. The surrounding marrow contains fat and a mixed population of hematopoietic cells. The morphology is consistent with large atypical plasma cells; confirmation with CD138 and kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry or ISH is recommended to assess extent and clonality. Findings are suggestive of plasma cell myeloma with large plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts line the bone surface in a single layer with a hof distant from the nucleus and are CD138/light chain negative, rather than forming interstitial clusters.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei, finely granular pink cytoplasm, and are CD61 positive, whereas plasma cells have round eccentric nuclei and are CD138 positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests often with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin positive, CD138 variable, without light chain restriction.
